copy.caption:

story.title: Perfect offense, tolerable defense give Cowboys something to build on; will they?
story.summary: Every NFC East team won last week, as the Cowboys take on the Eagles with a third-string quarterback. The Giants remain atop the division. A week after Dak Prescott said it would be disrespectful to the rest of the NFL to believe his offense could score on every drive in a game, the Dallas Cowboys did just that. The seven touchdowns and a field goal on those eight possessions in a 51-30 victory over the Tennessee Titans would be part of the reason team owner Jerry Jones said it would be “inaccurate” to conclude the win was a result of the Cowboys pulling play-calling duties from defensive coordinator Christian Parker. Dallas made the move to have veteran coach Mike Pettine call the defensive plays after a 46-40 loss to San Francisco in which the Cowboys set a club record by allowing 584 yards in a home game.
